mapper.select: SELECT m.NO AS memberNo, m.ID AS memberId, m.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID AS chatId FROM USER_MEMBER m JOIN USER_AUTHORITY a ON m.AUTHORITY_NO = a.NO WHERE m.BRIEF_YN = 1 AND m.TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID IS NOT NULL AND a.ROLE_NAME = 'USER' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BRIEF_LOG l WHERE l.MEMBER_NO = m.NO AND l.WEEK_START = #{weekStart} ) ORDER BY m.NO

SELECT p.`YEAR` AS `year`, p.`MONTH` AS `month`, p.`DATE` AS `date`, p.TITLE AS title, TIME_FORMAT(p.START_TIME, '%H:%i') AS startTime FROM PLAN p WHERE p.OWNER_ID = #{ownerId} AND (p.`YEAR` * 10000 + p.`MONTH` * 100 + p.`DATE`) BETWEEN #{fromKey} AND #{toKey} ORDER BY p.`YEAR`, p.`MONTH`, p.`DATE`, (p.START_TIME IS NULL) ASC, p.START_TIME ASC, p.NO ASC
